answer: I ran the 3-qubit GHZ circuit on the real sirius QPU with 100 shots. The circuit was H on q0, CNOT q0 to q1, CNOT q1 to q2, then a measurement on all 3 qubits. The job ID is 01a15f57-2b59-76d9-b0c0-c92ccaaa031e and it completed. The counts were 000: 38, 111: 50, 101: 4, 001: 2, 011: 2, 100: 2, 010: 1, 110: 1. That makes 88 of 100 shots 000 or 111, a fraction of 0.88. Before the real run I checked the circuit once on the free sirius:mock alias (job 01a15f57-0536-75e1-b0cf-71c0c04d5a67), which returned 000 for all 100 shots. About credits: the API reported 1.0 billed second for the real job. The API has no credit field. The helper multiplied the billed seconds by the published sirius rate of 0.3 credits per second, which gives 0.3 credits. The Resonance dashboard shows the exact charge. The QASM file and runner script are in /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-361/scratch/.
